title: Brazilian winger Allan joins Man City from Palmeiras in 'surreal' move
desc: Brazilian winger Allan completed a transfer to Manchester City from Palmeiras for a reported 34 million pounds ($46 million) on Monday and described the move as “surreal.” The 22-year-old Allan takes the place in the City squad vacated by Savio, who joined Tottenham last week, and is likely to play the same role as his compatriot — as a backup. “This is a surreal moment for me,” Allan said in a City statement, in which he said it was an easy decision to move to the club.
